steps.title: Euthanize and Preserve Mosquitoes
steps.instruction: Euthanize collected mosquitoes and preserve them for storage.

substeps.instruction: Euthanize mosquitoes in a −80 °C freezer.
Preserve mosquitoes in DNA/RNA Shield.
Label each specimen with a unique ID.
Store overnight at 4 °C.
Transfer to −20 °C for up to four months prior to transport at room temperature.

steps.title: Mechanical Disruption
steps.instruction: Squish the mosquito using Zymo Research's individual squisher molecules.

steps.title: Lysis and Protein Digestion
steps.instruction: Wash specimens and incubate in lysis buffer to digest proteins.

substeps.instruction: Wash specimens three times with 1× PBS.
Incubate in lysis buffer containing 20 µL of Proteinase K (20 mg/mL) and 200 µL of PBS at 55 °C for 1 h.

steps.title: Phenol-Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform organic extraction to separate DNA from proteins.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1) and mix by inversion 10 times.
Centrifuge at 12000 g for 10 min at 4 °C.
Recover the aqueous upper phase in a new tube without touching the interface.

steps.title: Chloroform Purification
steps.instruction: Further purify the aqueous phase using chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of chloroform and mix 10 times by inversion.
Centrifuge at 12000 g for 10 min at 4 °C.
Recover the aqueous upper phase in a new tube without touching the interface.
Add an equal volume of 100% ethanol, mix 10 times by inversion, and precipitate for 30 minutes at -70 °C.
Centrifuge at 16000 g for 10 min at 4 °C.
Discard the ethanol.

steps.title: DNA Washing and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellets and resuspend in water.

substeps.instruction: Wash pellets twice with 75% ethanol.
Air-dry the pellets.
Resuspend in 24 µL of nuclease-free water.

steps.title: DNA Cleaning and Concentration
steps.instruction: Further improve DNA purity using a commercial kit.

substeps.instruction: Clean DNA using the DNA Clean and Concentrator™-5 kit (Zymo Research).
Elute in 14 µL of nuclease-free water.

steps.title: Quality Assessment and Storage
steps.instruction: Assess DNA quality and store samples.

substeps.instruction: Assess DNA concentration, purity, and integrity using Qubit, NanoDrop, and Agilent TapeStation.
Store samples at −20 °C until further use.

steps.title: Library Preparation and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Prepare the sequencing library and load onto flow cells.

substeps.instruction: Use DNA inputs ranging from 40 to 1180 nanograms (fragment sizes 5592 bp to 24138 bp).
Prepare the library using the Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) Ligation Sequencing Kit (SQK-LSK114) following the Native DNA sequencing protocol, without fragmentation or PCR amplification.
Load final libraries onto PromethION flow cells (R10.4.1).
Analyze sequence data using a computer running Ubuntu 22.04.4 LTS (Intel Core i9-14900K CPU, 128 GB RAM, two NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPUs with 24 GB VRAM each).
